-- REQ: LANG-1171 LANG-1172 LANG-1173 LANG-1174 /-- Documentation comment. -/ namespace Demo /- outer /- nested -/ still a comment -/ structure Point where x : Nat y : Nat deriving Repr def area (w h : Nat) : Nat := w * h theorem area_comm (w h : Nat) : area w h = area h w := by unfold area rw [Nat.mul_comm] @[simp] theorem zero_area (h : Nat) : area 0 h = 0 := by simp [area] def greet (name : String) : String := s!"Hello, {name}!\n" #eval greet "lean" example : 2 + 2 = 4 := rfl end Demo
